core_philosophy: Conservative capital preservation portfolio emphasizing low-volatility equity, dividend income, short-duration Treasuries, and inflation protection. Designed to minimize drawdowns while preserving purchasing power.
behavioral_commitment: Prioritize stability over chasing returns. This portfolio is the anchor — do not shift to growth during bull markets. Rebalance mechanically on schedule.

intentional_overlap.USMV_and_SCHD: USMV and SCHD overlap in large-cap U.S. equities. Intentional to double-weight defensive, income-generating stocks within the equity sleeve.
intentional_overlap.SGOV_VGSH_VTIP: Three short-duration fixed income instruments serve distinct roles: SGOV for cash-like safety, VGSH for slightly longer duration, and VTIP for inflation protection.

target_allocation.name: iShares MSCI USA Min Vol Factor ETF

notes: Tax-deferred account — no tax impact on internal rebalancing.
50% fixed income / 40% equity / 10% gold allocation reflects conservative posture.
SGOV serves as the near-cash reserve within the portfolio.
VTIP and GLDM together provide dual-layer inflation protection.
USMV selected over broad market to reduce portfolio beta.
